name: Redbull Freezer [B42]
description: Small chest freezer with a silver Red Bull design, custom icons and blue light when powered. Choose how often freezers use the Red Bull look. 10 options; default: 100%. Visual fill: below 15% looks empty; at 15%, cans and ice appear; at 30%, it looks full. Works with power on or off. You can keep adding items normally.
